name: Jigger
description: Measures spirits, juices and syrups accurately before mixing. This double-sided example holds 30 ml and 60 ml; capacities vary by model.
image_subject: stainless steel double-sided Japanese cocktail jigger with two conical cups joined at the waist

name: Measuring cup
description: A graduated cup for measuring larger quantities when batching cocktails. Read the scale at eye level.
image_subject: small clear graduated measuring jug with pouring spout and handle

name: Measuring spoons
description: Measures small amounts of sugar, spices and other ingredients. Use a calibrated spoon when a recipe specifies a precise volume.
image_subject: nested set of stainless steel measuring spoons

name: Digital scale
description: Weighs ingredients for repeatable syrups, infusions and cocktail batches. Especially useful for ratios specified by mass.
image_subject: compact digital kitchen scale with stainless steel weighing platform and blank display

name: Boston shaker
description: A two-piece shaker for chilling, diluting and aerating cocktails with ice. This example uses two metal tins and requires a separate strainer.
image_subject: two stainless steel Boston shaker tins of different sizes standing side by side

name: Cobbler shaker
description: A three-piece shaker with a body, built-in strainer and cap. Useful for shaking individual cocktails; fine-strain separately when needed.
image_subject: three-piece stainless steel cobbler cocktail shaker assembled with domed strainer top and small cap

name: Parisian shaker
description: A two-piece shaker with a fitted metal top and no built-in strainer. Also called a French shaker; use a separate strainer after shaking.
image_subject: elegant two-piece stainless steel Parisian French cocktail shaker with rounded fitted top and no small cap

name: Mixing glass
description: A spouted vessel for stirring cocktails with ice. Allows controlled chilling and dilution with less aeration than shaking.
image_subject: heavy clear cut-glass cocktail mixing beaker with pouring spout

name: Bar spoon
description: A long-handled spoon for stirring, layering and transferring small quantities. Spoon bowls vary in size and are not always calibrated measures.
image_subject: single long stainless steel bar spoon with twisted shaft and small oval bowl

name: Muddler
description: Gently presses herbs, fruit or sugar to release flavor. Use a light touch with delicate herbs to avoid excessive bitterness.
image_subject: wooden cocktail muddler with broad flat blunt base

name: Swizzle stick
description: A branched mixing tool rotated between the palms to mix and chill drinks with crushed ice. A traditional wooden example is called a bois lele.
image_subject: traditional wooden bois lele swizzle stick with star shaped branched end

name: Hawthorne strainer
description: A spring-edged strainer that holds back ice when pouring from a shaker or mixing vessel. Pair with a fine strainer to catch smaller particles.
image_subject: stainless steel Hawthorne cocktail strainer with coiled spring around round perforated plate and short handle

name: Julep strainer
description: A perforated bowl-shaped strainer commonly used with a mixing glass to retain stirring ice while pouring.
image_subject: stainless steel julep strainer with shallow oval perforated bowl and handle

name: Fine-mesh strainer
description: Catches small ice shards, pulp and herb fragments during double straining. Hold above the serving glass while pouring through the primary strainer.
image_subject: small stainless steel conical fine mesh cocktail strainer with long handle

name: Funnel
description: Transfers syrups, juices and batched drinks into narrow-necked bottles. A plain funnel does not filter solids.
image_subject: small stainless steel funnel with narrow stem

name: Filter bag
description: A reusable fine cloth bag for filtering infusions and prepared ingredients. Choose a food-safe mesh suited to the desired texture.
image_subject: white fine mesh food filtering bag with drawstring opening

name: Citrus press
description: A hinged hand press for extracting lemon or lime juice. Choose a bowl size appropriate for the fruit and strain seeds as needed.
image_subject: stainless steel hinged handheld citrus squeezer with two long handles

name: Citrus reamer
description: A ridged handheld tool twisted into halved citrus to extract juice. Strain the juice to remove seeds and unwanted pulp.
image_subject: wooden handheld citrus reamer with ridged pointed head and short handle

name: Y-peeler
description: Cuts broad strips of citrus peel for twists and expressed oils. Avoid taking too much bitter white pith.
image_subject: stainless steel Y-shaped vegetable and citrus peeler

name: Channel knife
description: Cuts narrow strips of citrus zest for decorative twists and spirals.
image_subject: cocktail channel knife with small hooked metal cutting head and black handle

name: Fine grater
description: Finely grates citrus zest, nutmeg and other aromatic garnishes. Grate only the colored outer layer when zesting citrus.
image_subject: long narrow stainless steel rasp style fine grater with black handle

name: Paring knife
description: A small sharp knife for cutting citrus wedges, trimming fruit and preparing precise garnishes.
image_subject: small stainless steel paring knife with black handle

name: Cutting board
description: Provides a stable food-safe surface for preparing fruit and garnishes. Keep clean and separate from raw meat preparation.
image_subject: small rectangular wooden cutting board

name: Garnish tweezers
description: Positions delicate herbs, flowers and other small garnishes accurately without crushing them.
image_subject: long stainless steel culinary garnish tweezers with fine tips

name: Cocktail pick
description: Holds olives, cherries or other garnishes together for presentation and convenient serving.
image_subject: single stainless steel cocktail pick with ring end and pointed shaft

name: Glass rimmer
description: Shallow trays for moistening and coating glass rims with salt, sugar or spice mixtures.
image_subject: black three-tier folding cocktail glass rimmer with empty round shallow trays

name: Ice scoop
description: Transfers ice hygienically from a bin to a shaker or glass. Use a dedicated scoop rather than a drinking glass.
image_subject: stainless steel ice scoop with deep bowl and short handle

name: Ice tongs
description: Grips individual ice cubes for controlled and hygienic placement in a drink.
image_subject: stainless steel ice tongs with serrated curved gripping tips

name: Ice pick
description: Splits or shapes large ice blocks for cocktail service. Use a stable surface and keep the supporting hand clear of the point.
image_subject: single pointed stainless steel ice pick with wooden handle

name: Lewis bag
description: A sturdy canvas bag used with an ice mallet to crush ice while absorbing some surface moisture.
image_subject: cream canvas Lewis ice crushing bag folded open at the top

name: Ice mallet
description: Crushes ice inside a Lewis bag for juleps, swizzles and other crushed-ice drinks.
image_subject: solid wooden ice mallet with cylindrical head and handle

name: Large ice mold
description: Freezes large cubes for drinks served over ice. Large pieces generally melt more slowly than the same mass of small ice under similar conditions.
image_subject: black silicone four cavity large square ice cube mold empty

name: Bottle opener
description: Removes crown caps from bottled mixers, beer and other capped ingredients.
image_subject: flat stainless steel bar blade bottle opener

name: Waiter's corkscrew
description: A folding tool with a worm, lever and foil knife for opening cork-sealed wine and fortified wine bottles.
image_subject: folding waiters corkscrew with worm and two stage lever extended and dark handle

name: Speed pourer
description: Fits a bottle neck to provide a controlled stream while pouring. Verify quantities with a measure when accuracy is required.
image_subject: single stainless steel liquor speed pourer with black rubber bottle stopper

name: Dasher bottle
description: Dispenses bitters and tinctures in small dashes. Dash volume depends on the bottle, fill level and pouring technique.
image_subject: small empty cut glass bitters bottle with stainless steel dasher top

name: Atomizer
description: Applies a fine mist of aromatic liquid, such as an absinthe rinse, over a glass or finished drink.
image_subject: small clear glass cocktail atomizer bottle with silver spray pump

name: Dropper
description: Adds small quantities of saline, tinctures or extracts. Drop size varies; use a calibrated pipette for precise volume measurements.
image_subject: clear glass dropper pipette with black rubber bulb

name: Squeeze bottle
description: Stores and dispenses prepared syrups, juices and sauces during service. Label contents and preparation dates separately.
image_subject: empty translucent food-safe squeeze bottle with narrow nozzle cap

name: Blender
description: Blends ingredients and ice into frozen cocktails. Use equipment rated for ice and follow the manufacturer filling limits.
image_subject: countertop blender with clear empty jug lid and brushed steel base

name: Drink mixer
description: A spindle mixer for flash blending cocktails with crushed ice. Useful for quickly aerating tropical drinks.
image_subject: single spindle countertop drink mixer with tall stainless steel mixing cup

name: Soda siphon
description: Dispenses carbonated water to lengthen cocktails. Use only compatible chargers and liquids allowed by the manufacturer.
image_subject: stainless steel soda siphon bottle with black dispensing lever and spout

name: Cream whipper
description: A pressure-rated culinary siphon for compatible foams and whipped toppings. Follow the manufacturer instructions for contents, chargers and temperature.
image_subject: stainless steel culinary cream whipper siphon with dispensing nozzle and charger holder

name: Smoking gun
description: Adds aromatic smoke to a glass or covered serving vessel. Use culinary smoking materials and follow the equipment ventilation guidance.
image_subject: compact handheld culinary smoking gun with metal burn chamber and flexible black hose

name: Absinthe spoon
description: A flat perforated spoon that rests across a glass to support sugar during traditional absinthe service.
image_subject: ornate flat stainless steel perforated absinthe spoon

name: Rocks glass
description: A short tumbler for spirits and cocktails served over ice, including an Old Fashioned. Also called an old-fashioned glass.
image_subject: empty clear straight sided rocks tumbler with thick base

name: Highball glass
description: A tall tumbler for mixed drinks served with ice and a lengthening mixer, such as soda or tonic.
image_subject: empty clear tall highball tumbler

name: Collins glass
description: A tall narrow glass for long drinks such as a Tom Collins. Glass dimensions and capacities vary between manufacturers.
image_subject: empty clear very tall slender cylindrical Collins glass

name: Coupe glass
description: A stemmed glass with a shallow rounded bowl for chilled cocktails served without ice.
image_subject: empty clear stemmed cocktail coupe with shallow rounded bowl

name: Martini glass
description: A stemmed glass with a conical bowl for chilled cocktails served up. Hold the stem to limit warming the drink.
image_subject: empty clear classic V-shaped stemmed martini glass

name: Nick & Nora glass
description: A small stemmed glass with a curved bowl for compact cocktails served up.
image_subject: empty clear small stemmed Nick and Nora cocktail glass with curved tulip bowl

name: Champagne flute
description: A narrow stemmed glass for sparkling wine and sparkling cocktails such as a French 75.
image_subject: empty clear narrow stemmed champagne flute

name: Wine glass
description: A stemmed bowl for wine-based cocktails and spritzes, with room for ice and aromatic garnishes when required.
image_subject: empty clear stemmed white wine glass

name: Margarita glass
description: A stemmed glass with a broad stepped bowl, traditionally associated with Margaritas and suitable for a salt rim.
image_subject: empty clear stemmed margarita glass with wide stepped double bowl

name: Hurricane glass
description: A tall curved footed glass for tropical cocktails and long drinks served over ice.
image_subject: empty clear hurricane cocktail glass with curved tall bowl and short foot

name: Copper mug
description: A handled mug associated with Mule cocktails. Use a food-safe lined mug for acidic drinks.
image_subject: empty copper Moscow Mule mug with visible stainless steel lining and curved handle

name: Julep cup
description: A metal cup for Mint Juleps and other crushed-ice drinks. The chilled surface can develop a characteristic frost.
image_subject: empty silver stainless steel mint julep cup with beaded rim

name: Irish coffee glass
description: A handled heat-resistant glass for Irish Coffee and other warm drinks. Use glassware rated for hot liquids.
image_subject: empty clear footed Irish coffee glass with handle

name: Shot glass
description: A small glass for serving shots and miniature drinks. Serving glasses are not necessarily calibrated measuring tools.
image_subject: empty clear small shot glass with thick base
